_doc: Scientific audit of the served model. label_reconstruction_complete stays false while the served model is trained on the uncorrected labels.
title: Scientific warning: 5 November 2026 audit of the v3 model, with the 13 November correction
summary: The displayed v3 model was trained on labels that do not mainly measure new water in the marshland. With Sentinel-1C and 1D corrected (13 November 2026), the forecast still beats the recent-water rule, by less than published, and only at the lake shore. Inland there is no demonstrated skill. Do not use v3 to recommend interventions in the marshland.
findings: 83% (7-day) and 87% (14-day) of formation events lie within 100 m of the lake.

Sentinel-1C verifies 80% (7-day) and 73% (14-day) of evaluation events and is not harmonised. On track 123 over 500 m from the lake, Sentinel-1A verified 0 events in 23,195 rows and Sentinel-1C verified 385 in 20,783.
297 of the 598 evaluated sites are outside Gikomero Sector.

Correction of 13 November 2026 (E1): with Sentinel-1C and 1D brought onto Sentinel-1A, 98% of events lie within 100 m of the lake. Rerun of the v3 protocol: PR-AUC 0.599 against 0.534 for the recent-water rule at 7 days and 0.569 against 0.484 at 14 days (published: 0.786 and 0.663). Inside the sector and over 500 m from the lake there were 17 events at 4 locations in a year, and the forecast scored below the rule.
required_before_upgrade: Serve a model trained on the corrected labels, describe it as a lake-shore forecast, and archive its forecasts before their outcomes (H1). A marshland forecast needs a label that detects small or vegetated water, checked against sensors or field visits.
